code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. Elevated ferritin and D-dimer suggest inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Renal function is impaired (elevated creatinine), and glucose is low. Mildly increased CRP supports an inflammatory process. Findings may indicate acute systemic illness (e.g., infection, inflammation, or hypoxic injury) with possible renal involvement; urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
